Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Waveform Class¶

class Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Waveform(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The Waveform commands are used to read the waveform data and its related settings.

__init__(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Initialize Waveform commands.

Parameters:

  • instrument (Instrument) – The instrument instance

  • data_handler (Data_Handler) – The data handler instance

get_data()[source]¶

Read the waveform data. If autosave is on, then also saves them to a csv file.

Returns:

Raw waveform data (format depends on :WAVeform:FORMat)

Return type:

str or bytes

get_format()[source]¶

Query the return format of the waveform data.

Returns:

“WORD”, “BYTE”, or “ASC”

Return type:

str

Returns:

“NORM”, “MAX”, or “RAW”

str

get_preamble()[source]¶

Query and return all the waveform parameters.

Returns:

10 waveform parameters separated by commas

Return type:

str

str

get_xincrement()[source]¶

Query the time difference between two neighboring points of the specified channel source in the X direction.

Returns:

X increment (seconds or Hz)

Return type:

float

get_xorigin()[source]¶

Query the start time of the waveform data of the channel source currently selected in the X direction.

Returns:

float: X origin (seconds or Hz)

Return type:

float

get_xreference()[source]¶

Returns:

X reference (usually 0)

Return type:

int

Returns:

Y increment (amplitude unit)

float

Y origin

int

Y reference (usually 127)

int
